name: linux_kernel
description: Linux-kernel token supplements for /audit's per-function strategy inference (core/audit/strategy.py). Loaded ONLY when the target looks like a kernel tree / module (core/audit/vocab_packs.py gating) and merged additively with the universal signal maps. These tokens used to be hardcoded in the generic maps for every target; project-specific vocabulary should come from the study loop's domain model (infer_strategies consumes DomainVocabulary), not from growing this file.
